title.ja: SHAKEとRATTLE：拘束と運動量の違い
title.en: SHAKE and RATTLE: constraints and momentum ownership

summary.ja: 単振り子の10固定軌道で、位置拘束、全時刻の接線運動量と内部点の中心化運動量を区別します。
summary.en: Ten fixed pendulum evolutions distinguish position constraints, full-time tangent momentum and interior centered momentum.

assumptions.en: L=m=g=1, initial angle 0.7 and zero angular velocity. C=(q·q−1)/2, T=100 and h=0.04/0.02/0.01; position targets are fixed at 1e−13, with a coarse 1e−10 companion.

algorithm.ja: 独自のスカラーNewton位置拘束、RATTLE終端接線impulse、SHAKE位置対。SHAKEの運動量は内部点だけで中心化し、端点を作りません。 SHAKEのsolves列はeta、eta/h^2、位置残差、Newton更新数です。列1は一律にeta/h^2ですが、初回半刻みの物理乗数は2eta/h^2、以後の位置Verletではeta/h^2です。逆位置対はすべて後者です。判定と図はこの列1を使いません。
algorithm.en: Original scalar Newton position constraints, RATTLE final tangent impulses and SHAKE position pairs. SHAKE momentum is centered only at interior nodes; endpoint momenta are absent. SHAKE solves columns are eta, eta/h^2, position residual and Newton updates. Column1 uses the uniform recurrence normalization eta/h^2. For the first constrained half-step startup, the physical multiplier is 2*eta/h^2; later full position-Verlet steps use eta/h^2. Reverse-pair steps all use the later recurrence convention. RATTLE has its separate five-column normalization. No scientific gate or plot uses SHAKE column1.

validation.ja: 独立Jacobi解析族と角度系DOP853の資格、74主判定。有限Cの中心化恒等式、2段階FDの縮約写像診断、位置対／全状態の逆積分を分離。
validation.en: A separately qualified Jacobi family and angular DOP853 reference support 74 main decisions. Finite-C centered identities, two-delta reduced-map diagnostics and position-pair versus full-state reversals are distinct.

limits.ja: 原著SHAKE/RATTLE本文は未読で、著者講義ノートの選択箇所を確認。有限差分のsymplectic defectは一般証明ではなく、中心化SHAKE速度にRATTLEの接線拘束を要求しません。
limits.en: Original SHAKE and RATTLE full texts remain unread; selected author lecture notes were inspected. The finite-difference symplectic defect is a local proxy, not a general proof, and centered SHAKE velocity is not assigned RATTLE tangency.

title.ja: 離心率を変えたKepler軌道と時間刻み

summary.ja: e=0.1/0.7の16固定軌道で、保存量と同時刻の位相誤差、実際の近日点時刻と逆積分を比較します。
summary.en: Sixteen fixed evolutions at e=0.1/0.7 compare invariants, same-time phase error, physical periapsis times and reversal.

assumptions.ja: a=μ=換算質量=1、軟化なし。1周期は512/1024/2048刻み、10周期は基準2048刻み/周期。変動刻みh=h0|q|を現在状態から定め、最後だけ物理終端へ短縮。
assumptions.en: a=mu=reduced mass=1, without softening. One-period runs use 512/1024/2048 steps; ten-period controls use h0=2π/2048. Variable steps use h=h0|q| at the current state, with only the final step shortened to the physical endpoint.

algorithm.ja: 独自の中心力KDK Verlet。固定・保存刻み再生・再生成刻みを区別し、cubic Hermite軌道の正の放射速度交差をbrentqで局在化。
algorithm.en: Original central-force KDK Verlet. Fixed, replayed and regenerated schedules are distinct. Positive radial crossings of cubic Hermite trajectories are localized by brentq.

validation.ja: 独立のKepler方程式brentq／二分法解析族、92主判定。全状態誤差とエネルギー・角運動量、8回以上の近日点、有限窓の順序と反転誤差を検査。
validation.en: An independent Kepler-equation family, qualified with brentq and bisection, supports 92 main decisions: full-state error, energy/angular momentum, at least eight periapses, finite-window order and reversal defects.

limits.ja: 保存量の小さい誤差から位相精度を推論しません。変動刻み写像の正準symplectic defectは測定せず、固定hの性質をそのまま移しません。初期解像度R1は数値実行前の漸近解析でR2へ改訂。
limits.en: Small invariant errors do not establish phase accuracy. No canonical symplectic-defect measurement is claimed for the variable-step map, and fixed-h properties are not transferred automatically. R1 resolution was revised to R2 using pre-execution asymptotic planning, not measured calibration.

title.ja: 結合した2周波数系と共鳴の有限窓

summary.ja: 2自由度の実結合系で、12の64刻みprobeと6の精度軌道を使い、真のモード、座標間交換、離散写像と丸めを分けます。
summary.en: A genuinely coupled two-degree-of-freedom system uses twelve 64-step probes and six accuracy trajectories to separate normal modes, coordinate exchange, discrete maps and roundoff.

assumptions.ja: α=1、ω=10/20、q0=(1,1/ω)、p0=0。中心probeは保存binary64のhとsin/cosをそのまま使い、πへ丸め直しません。
assumptions.en: alpha=1, omega=10/20, q0=(1,1/omega) and p0=0. Central probes retain the evaluated binary64 h and sin/cos coefficients without snapping to mathematical pi.

algorithm.ja: 全ポテンシャルVerletと、B半kick・A厳密flow・B半kickのStrang impulse。Aには高速調和振動子と低速自由流、Bには低速位置項と結合を含めます。
algorithm.en: Full-potential Verlet and a Strang impulse composition: half B kick, exact A flow, half B kick. A contains the fast oscillator and slow free drift; B contains the slow potential and the coupling.

validation.ja: 116主判定。独立の結合固有モード解析、保存係数Decimal80/120・Fraction写像、段階別γ8丸め上界を区別。理想πのJordan構造は有理恒等式で別確認。 各probeは現在保存した係数hexからDecimal80/120を評価し、6精度軌道はDecimal80を用います。
validation.en: The 116 main decisions distinguish independent coupled normal modes, Decimal80/120 and Fraction frozen-coefficient maps, and stagewise gamma8 roundoff allowances. Ideal-pi Jordan structure is checked separately by rational identities. Each probe uses the current saved coefficient hex for its own Decimal80/120 actions; six accuracy actions use Decimal80.

limits.ja: 中心の実浮動係数写像はunresolvedとし、理想πのJordan性を移しません。64刻み増幅と小さい固定入力の観測であり、走査した共鳴図・一般安定性・長時間の普遍誤差定理は主張しません。
limits.en: The central actual floating map remains unresolved; ideal-pi Jordan structure is not transferred to it. Results concern 64-step amplification and small fixed inputs, not a scanned resonance diagram, general stability or a universal long-time error theorem.
